before.rendered:
Inamo — Reason:
The sources give different accounts; no single explanation is established here.
Inamo — The Codex of Ultima Wisdom:
Not in this guide — from outside research: The Ultima Codex's Inamo article says Inamo was likely an unexpected bystander when he was killed.

Christopher — The Codex of Ultima Wisdom:
Not in this guide — from outside research: The Ultima Codex's Christopher article says Inamo was killed apparently so that he could not witness the crime.

Klog — The Codex of Ultima Wisdom:
Not in this guide — from outside research: The Ultima Codex's Klog article describes Inamo as a gargoyle killed to silence a witness.
